name: combinators
description: Generic opaque first-order linear arrows, adapted from the approach described by Phil Freeman and rightfold; real Rust resources move through an interpreter.

cases.reason: Generic composition, tensor, swap, associators and replay.
Descriptions may be shared; tensor requires two separate input resources.
Explicit unsafeCoerce is outside the safe API guarantee; not executed.
The first finish outputs Int, not Session.
Only unrestricted Int values have a duplication primitive.
Identity cannot erase its resource; no generic discard primitive exists.
The arrow constructor is private.
Ordinary unrestricted functions are not accepted as linear arrows.
Safe.Coerce cannot expose unrestricted resource execution.
Input type role is nominal.
Output type role is nominal.
Only closed Int-to-Int workflows may execute.
The trusted raw instruction builder is private.
There is no arbitrary lift of an unrestricted callback.
Historical runShared/liftShared accept shared Int values. Typecheck only; historical foreign implementations are not executed.
Historical Sub composition keeps a non-Shared resource internal. Typecheck only; historical foreign implementations are not executed.
No Clone instance for Session.
No Drop instance for Session.
Shared constraint prevents lifting unrestricted callbacks on Session.
